description.default: RE Reader: a standalone EPUB/PDF reader for SiYuan. Shelf, PDF & EPUB rendering, word lookup with offline MDX dictionaries, machine translation, bilingual parallel reading, ink annotations, reading stats and TTS — plus an AI reading assistant that reads the current chapter, cites passages and saves answers as notes. Readest-style reading experience.
description.zh-CN: RE 阅读器：思源笔记的独立 EPUB/PDF 阅读器。书架管理、PDF 与 EPUB 渲染、离线 MDX 词典划词查词、机器翻译与双语对照、本地墨迹批注、阅读时长统计与朗读（TTS），并内置 AI 阅读助手：按章节提问、引用回跳、一键存为思源笔记。批注、进度与设置全部本地独立存储。
